note: The Division Leaders of The Qira Hive (https://wynncraft.wiki.gg/wiki/The_Qira_Hive_(Quest)). Hand-curated like the raid, dungeon and altar bosses: they do not speak, so the dialogue mining never saw them. Four of the five are here; Gale leads the Air Division but talks the player through the fight, so she is mined like any other character and pinned to the same tier in data/tier_overrides.json. Qira herself is not a Division Leader and sits a tier above them. Merged into the playable set by scripts/build_card_set.py at the tier below.
